title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 417A (Qualifications, terms and conditions of service of Chairperson and Member)

content.overview: Notwithstanding anything in this Act, the qualifications, appointment, term, salaries, resignation, removal and other conditions of service of the Chairperson and Members of the Appellate Tribunal appointed after the Tribunals Reforms Act, 2021 are governed by Chapter II of that Act.
content.glance: Notwithstanding anything in this Act, the qualifications, appointment, term, salaries, resignation, removal and other conditions of service of the Chairperson and Members of the Appellate Tribunal appointed after the Tribunals Reforms Act, 2021 are governed by Chapter II of that Act.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 417A (Qualifications, terms and conditions of service of Chairperson and Member). Notwithstanding anything in this Act, the qualifications, appointment, term, salaries, resignation, removal and other conditions of service of the Chairperson and Members of the Appellate Tribunal appointed after the Tribunals Reforms Act, 2021 are governed by Chapter II of that Act. Apply only the conditions, approvals, filings and penalties stated in the section. A rule made under the Act cannot contradict the section. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Persons appointed before the earlier Finance Act changes continue under the previous regime as the proviso states. The section is a bridge to the Tribunals Reforms Act.
